game_title: Edge Case Hunter – Scarab Burrow Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow, a scarab burrow: the caravan guide must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Edge Case Hunter: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow: a scarab burrow
core_gameplay_loop: In Scarab Burrow, repeat each round: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code. Each round, desert bandits strike the palm grove, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the edge_cases value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the palm grove from desert bandits in Scarab Burrow: keep the edge_cases meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: edge_cases drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Edge Case Hunter
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Edge Case Hunter' (Week 9 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Scarab Burrow'. region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how edge_cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against desert bandits in Scarab Burrow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 76 seconds while edge_cases > 0.
